metadata.dictionary_name: StudentLife daily behavioral feature dictionary for LLM input

phonelock.description: Features derived from observed phone-locked episodes. These features describe periods in which the phone was locked, not phone unlock events.

phone_locked_episode_count.definition: Number of phone-locked episodes observed during the day.
phone_locked_episode_count.calculation: Counts phone lock records for the participant on that day.
phone_locked_episode_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more observed phone-locked episodes during the day.
phone_locked_episode_count.caution: Do not interpret this feature as a count of phone unlocks. It represents observed phone-locked episodes and is a proxy for periods without direct phone use.

phone_locked_night_episode_count.definition: Number of phone-locked episodes that started during the night period.
phone_locked_night_episode_count.calculation: Counts phone lock records with start time between 00:00 and 06:00.
phone_locked_night_episode_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more observed phone-locked episodes during the night.
phone_locked_night_episode_count.caution: Do not interpret this feature as a count of phone unlocks. It only represents observed phone-locked episodes that started between 00:00 and 06:00.

first_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.definition: Start hour of the first phone-locked episode observed during the day.
first_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.calculation: Takes the earliest phone lock start time for the day. The technical table already stores this value as decimal hour of day; the LLM JSON keeps it as hour of day rounded to two decimal places.
first_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.interpretation: Lower values indicate an earlier first observed phone-locked episode.
first_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.caution: Do not interpret this feature as a phone unlock event. It only describes the start hour of the first observed phone-locked episode.

last_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.definition: Start hour of the last phone-locked episode observed during the day.
last_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.calculation: Takes the latest phone lock start time for the day. The technical table already stores this value as decimal hour of day; the LLM JSON keeps it as hour of day rounded to two decimal places.
last_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.interpretation: Higher values indicate a later last observed phone-locked episode.
last_phone_locked_episode_start_hour.caution: Do not interpret this feature as a phone unlock event. It only describes the start hour of the last observed phone-locked episode.

phone_locked_total_duration_hours.definition: Total duration during the day in which the phone was locked.
phone_locked_total_duration_hours.calculation: Calculates the union duration of phone-locked intervals for the day and converts seconds to hours.
phone_locked_total_duration_hours.interpretation: Higher values indicate more total observed time with the phone locked.
phone_locked_total_duration_hours.caution: Do not interpret this feature as phone unlock duration. It is a proxy for observed time with the phone locked and without direct phone use.

dark.description: Features derived from periods in which the phone was detected in a dark environment.

dark_environment_total_duration_hours.definition: Total duration during the day in which the phone was in a dark environment.
dark_environment_total_duration_hours.calculation: Calculates the union duration of dark-environment intervals for the day and converts seconds to hours.
dark_environment_total_duration_hours.interpretation: Higher values indicate more observed time with the phone in a dark environment.
dark_environment_total_duration_hours.caution: Do not interpret this feature as sleep. It only indicates that the phone was detected in a dark environment.

longest_dark_episode_start_hour.definition: Start hour of the longest dark-environment episode during the day.
longest_dark_episode_start_hour.calculation: Finds the dark-environment episode with the longest duration and uses its start time. The technical table already stores this value as decimal hour of day; the LLM JSON keeps it as hour of day rounded to two decimal places.
longest_dark_episode_start_hour.interpretation: This may indicate when the main observed dark-environment period began.
longest_dark_episode_start_hour.caution: Do not interpret this feature as sleep onset. It only indicates the start hour of the longest detected dark-environment episode.

dark_environment_episode_count.definition: Number of dark-environment episodes observed during the day.
dark_environment_episode_count.calculation: Counts dark-environment records for the participant on that day.
dark_environment_episode_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more fragmented observed periods in a dark environment.
dark_environment_episode_count.caution: Do not interpret this feature as sleep fragmentation. It only reflects observed dark-environment episodes.

activity.description: Features derived from smartphone-inferred physical activity records.

activity_active_record_ratio.definition: Proportion of valid smartphone-inferred activity records classified as active during the day.
activity_active_record_ratio.calculation: Records classified as walking or running are counted as active. Records classified as stationary are counted as non-active. Records classified as unknown are excluded from both the numerator and the denominator.
activity_active_record_ratio.interpretation: Higher values indicate that a larger proportion of valid activity records were classified as walking or running.
activity_active_record_ratio.caution: Do not interpret this ratio as exact chronological time spent active. Unknown activity records are excluded and must not be treated as inactive.

activity_state_transition_count.definition: Number of changes between consecutive valid inferred activity states during the day.
activity_state_transition_count.calculation: Orders valid activity records by timestamp, excludes unknown records, and counts changes between consecutive states: stationary, walking, or running.
activity_state_transition_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more alternation between inferred activity states during the day.
activity_state_transition_count.caution: This is based on inferred records and sampling frequency. It is not a direct measure of exact movement count.

activity_running_record_ratio.definition: Proportion of valid smartphone-inferred activity records classified as running during the day.
activity_running_record_ratio.calculation: Records classified as running are divided by all valid records classified as stationary, walking, or running. Unknown records are excluded.
activity_running_record_ratio.interpretation: Higher values indicate that a larger proportion of valid activity records were classified as running.
activity_running_record_ratio.caution: Do not interpret this ratio as exact time spent running or as a direct exercise measurement. Unknown activity records are excluded.

conversation.description: Features derived from episodes in which the phone detected conversation around the participant.

conversation_detected_total_duration_min.definition: Total duration of detected conversation episodes during the day.
conversation_detected_total_duration_min.calculation: Sums end_timestamp minus start_timestamp for conversation episodes and converts seconds to minutes.
conversation_detected_total_duration_min.interpretation: Higher values indicate more observed time around detected conversation.
conversation_detected_total_duration_min.caution: Do not infer conversation content, interlocutor, emotional quality, social support, or whether the conversation was socially meaningful.

conversation_detected_episode_count.definition: Number of detected conversation episodes during the day.
conversation_detected_episode_count.calculation: Counts conversation episode records for the participant on that day.
conversation_detected_episode_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more detected conversation episodes.
conversation_detected_episode_count.caution: Do not infer conversation content, interlocutor, emotional quality, or social support. It is a proxy for exposure to detected in-person conversation.

wifi_location.description: Features derived from Wi-Fi-inferred location labels. These labels are used as proxies for spatial context and mobility, not as GPS coordinates.

wifi_location_unique_label_count.definition: Number of distinct Wi-Fi-inferred location labels observed during the day.
wifi_location_unique_label_count.calculation: Counts distinct non-empty location labels for the participant on that day.
wifi_location_unique_label_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate a greater variety of observed Wi-Fi-inferred locations.
wifi_location_unique_label_count.caution: Do not interpret this feature as GPS, precise geographic distance, or a travel trajectory. The local data include labels such as in[...] and near[...].

wifi_primary_location_record_ratio.definition: Proportion of Wi-Fi location records concentrated in the most frequent location label during the day.
wifi_primary_location_record_ratio.calculation: Counts records by location label, selects the most frequent label, and divides its count by the total number of Wi-Fi location records that day.
wifi_primary_location_record_ratio.interpretation: Higher values indicate stronger concentration of observed records in one primary location.
wifi_primary_location_record_ratio.caution: Do not interpret this feature as precise time spent at a GPS location. It reflects concentration of Wi-Fi-inferred records.

wifi_location_transition_count.definition: Number of changes between consecutive Wi-Fi-inferred location labels.
wifi_location_transition_count.calculation: Orders Wi-Fi location records by time and counts changes between consecutive location labels.
wifi_location_transition_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more observed changes between Wi-Fi-inferred location labels.
wifi_location_transition_count.caution: Do not interpret this feature as a precise travel trajectory. It is a proxy for changes in Wi-Fi-inferred spatial context.

wifi_location_entropy.definition: Entropy of the distribution of Wi-Fi location records across location labels during the day.
wifi_location_entropy.calculation: Counts records per location label, converts counts to proportions, and calculates -sum(p_i * ln(p_i)).
wifi_location_entropy.interpretation: Lower values indicate concentration in fewer locations; higher values indicate records distributed across more locations.
wifi_location_entropy.caution: Do not interpret this feature as exact geographic distance, GPS mobility, or a travel trajectory. It describes diversity of Wi-Fi-inferred location records.

app_usage.description: Features derived from observed app/task records. These features describe records and timestamps, not exact app usage duration or screen time.

app_usage_task_record_count.definition: Number of app/task records observed during the day.
app_usage_task_record_count.calculation: Counts rows in the app usage file for the participant on that day.
app_usage_task_record_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more observed app/task records during the day.
app_usage_task_record_count.caution: Do not interpret this feature as screen time, app usage duration, or intentional active phone use. Multiple app/task records can share the same timestamp.

app_usage_unique_timestamp_count.definition: Number of distinct timestamps with app/task records during the day.
app_usage_unique_timestamp_count.calculation: Counts unique timestamp values among app usage records for the participant on that day.
app_usage_unique_timestamp_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate more distinct observed moments with app/task records.
app_usage_unique_timestamp_count.caution: Do not interpret this feature as app usage duration or screen time. It complements the task record count because one timestamp may contain multiple app/task records.

app_usage_unique_app_package_count.definition: Number of distinct app package names observed during the day.
app_usage_unique_app_package_count.calculation: Counts distinct values of RUNNING_TASKS_topActivity_mPackage for the participant on that day.
app_usage_unique_app_package_count.interpretation: Higher values indicate a greater diversity of observed app packages.
app_usage_unique_app_package_count.caution: Do not infer app categories, app purpose, or time spent in each app from this feature. It only measures diversity of observed package names.

app_usage_night_timestamp_ratio.definition: Proportion of distinct app usage timestamps that occurred during the night period.
app_usage_night_timestamp_ratio.calculation: Counts unique app usage timestamps between 00:00 and 06:00 and divides by the total number of unique app usage timestamps that day.
app_usage_night_timestamp_ratio.interpretation: Higher values indicate a larger proportion of observed app/task timestamps during the night.
app_usage_night_timestamp_ratio.caution: Do not interpret this feature as screen time or app usage duration. It is based on unique timestamps, not rows.
